The verdict is that two of the five findings should be fixed before merging (F3 and F4) and the other three can be dropped.

### [CONCERN] F3: KEEP — the stored range is never applied when a series is added
category: correctness
location: src/chart/use-chart-provider.ts:340-345

The range effect only acts when `seriesCountRef.current` is above zero, but it only re-runs when `mount.ready`, `chart` or `range` change. A ref changing doesn't cause a re-render. So when a consumer adds a series through `chart`, the effect doesn't run again, and the stored range waits for the next range change. The comment says this effect is what initiative 120 will rely on "the moment it adds the first series", but as written it won't run at that moment.

### [CONCERN] F4: KEEP — `error` is documented as the first error but holds the latest one
category: error-handling
location: src/chart/use-chart-provider.ts:97-99

`UseChartProviderResult.error` is documented as "The first error from any provider operation" (src/chart/chart-operations.ts:77). `setOperationError` replaces it with every new failure (`{ ...current, error: failure }`). The test "keeps the first error rather than being reset by a later success" (src/test/use-chart-provider.errors.test.tsx:234) only checks that a later success doesn't clear the error. It never checks what happens after a second failure. Either keep the first error and add a test for it, or change the doc comment to match the behavior.
